title: WE ought to serve only one God

lines.text: WE ought to serve only one God
We ought to love Him sincerely
We ought not to serve images
Because they are vain things to us.
We must always know that to be
redeemed
We must keep His commands
The comandments given by God
The comandments given by God
Ye Cherubim and Seraphim
Learn to love ye one another
It is in love that the Angels
Worship the Father up above.
Ye that trust in prayer get ready
To meet up with the Cherubim
The crown of Glory will be ours
That the worldly man cannot claim.
The promise He made to Moses
At the top of the Mount Sinai
He promised to always help him
To leads us to the Canaan’s land.
All ye the twenty-four elders
We bow down for thy mighty names
And ye the four holy creatures
Say ye Amen to all our prayers.
Jehovah Jireh Thou art King
Hark the prayers of the Cherubim
Jehovah Nissi our Father
Holy Trinity hear our prayers.
